tasks.spec:
You are fixing ONE seam defect: the mailroom's return leg no longer records a human decision. Your current working directory IS a git worktree — edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit. Do NOT git push. Do not load skills or call MCP/Apps. Fictional data only.

YOU OWN EXACTLY TWO FILES (edit one or both, nothing else):
  1. factory/outbox_listen.py
  2. factory/outbox_push.py
You may NOT edit any test file. The tests ARE the contract.

## The defect

tests/test_packet_id_flow.py::test_packet_id_round_trips_from_outbox_packet_to_approve_decision fails: after outbox_push.tick writes the ledger row for a card and a human APPROVE comment is read by outbox_listen.tick (reader stubbed), NO decisions.jsonl is written at all (FileNotFoundError on read-back). The decision-writing code exists in outbox_listen.py; the fixture's ledger row is evidently no longer treated as eligible for decision capture after the FYI-lifecycle rework (PR #21 added action_mode/fyi_only/lifecycle fields and filters). This failure reproduces IDENTICALLY on the pre-merge tree, so it is a mismatch between the return-leg contract (commit 1823e8c: 'packet_id survives, decisions reach the asker') and the reworked listener's eligibility rules — not a merge artifact.

Read tests/test_packet_id_flow.py FIRST — it is the truth of the flow: push a decision-mode card packet, listen to an APPROVE, and the decision row (carrying the same packet_id) must land in decisions.jsonl.

## The fix, in spirit

Find why listen's tick skips the row (trace eligibility: status, action_mode, fyi_only, lifecycle fields as written by push vs. as required by listen) and make the smallest honest change so a decision-mode card's human APPROVE is recorded with its packet_id. Do not weaken FYI-lifecycle behavior: fyi_only/ack flows and every other suite must keep passing. If push writes a field with one name and listen filters on another, fix the WRITER or the FILTER to agree — do not add a second field meaning the same thing.

## Run ALL until green

    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_packet_id_flow.py -q
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_outbox_push.py tests/test_outbox_listen.py tests/test_outbox_push_buzz.py tests/test_reescalate.py tests/test_urgency_seam.py -q

## fix-summary.md is NOT required for this task.
